title: Parsing an encoded gate list
statement: Let $g_1,\ldots,g_m$ be a finite list of arithmetic gates, and let $f$ be a natural-number parsing budget with $m\le f$. Parsing the Boolean encoding of this list with budget $f$ returns exactly the original list.
hypotheses_covered: $g_1,\ldots,g_m$ is a finite list of gates
the list length is at most $f$
